title: Completed Gap Analysis Report Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Gap Analysis Report artifact data payloads (PMO-01.04).

analysis_objective_and_scope.description: The strategic purpose and organizational business domain boundaries evaluated by this gap analysis.

current_state_summary.description: Executive summary of the baseline operating model, legacy systems, and existing operational capabilities.

desired_target_state.description: The envisioned future operating state, target business architecture, and required capability levels.

functional_and_process_gaps.description: Specific discrepancies identified between current operational workflows and target process efficiency standards.

technical_and_systems_gaps.description: Deficiencies in current software infrastructure, data architecture, security tooling, and integration capabilities.

people_and_competency_gaps.description: Human capital deficiencies, staffing shortages, and technical skill gaps required to sustain the target state.

risk_and_business_impact.description: The quantified operational risk, revenue exposure, and strategic impact of leaving identified gaps unaddressed.

closure_initiative_description.description: The specific project, enhancement sprint, or restructuring action designed to bridge the capability gap.

priority_and_execution_feasibility.description: The implementation urgency (Urgent/High/Medium/Low) and technical/financial execution feasibility rating.

assigned_owner_and_target_date.description: The accountable business lead and committed milestone target date for closing the capability gap.
